Name: Entomologist Bug Ranch Total Conversion
Author: PumpedFail
Description:
[i]Also see my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55316]mod [/url]replacing the default horse with a spider mount![/i]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55520/55520-1794628370-149502901.png[/img] [b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
Run a complete bug farm with this total replacement mod! All coop and barn animals (except dinosaurs) are replaced with insects, animal products have been replaced with insect products, and hundreds of dialogue, sound, sprite, quest, and other changes implemented to maintain the total immersion.

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55520/55520-1794628370-149502901.png[/img] Installation instructions[/b][/size]
- Unzip "Entomologist Bug Ranch.zip" into the Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
- Configure options using the mod config menu on the main menu or in the config menu in-game.
- Enjoy!

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55520/55520-1794628370-149502901.png[/img] Main features[/b][/size]
- Replaces all coop and barn livestock (except Dinosaurs) with arthropods: Roly Polies (all 5 chicken variants), Water Striders (Ducks), Woolly Bear Caterpillars (Rabbits), Emerald and Amber Aphids (Cows), Honeypot Ants (Goats), Silkworms (Sheep), Dung Beetles (Pigs), and Praying Mantises (Ostriches).
- Replaces 27 base products, artisan goods, and related food/treat sprites, names, and descriptions (including Isopod Oocytes, Honeydew Curd, Brood Balls, Shell Glaze, and Golden Arthropod Crackers) while keeping 100% vanilla item IDs for compatibility with other mods.
Choose how shared Wool and Cloth items display in-game: Silkworm (Silk Cocoon and Spun Silk Bolt), Woolly Bear (Caterpillar Setae and Spun Bristle Felt), or Hybrid.
- Reskins and renames processing machines, incubators, and tools to match the theme, including the Chitin Emulsifier, Nectar Condenser, Silk & Setae Loom, Shell Glaze Still, Oocyte Incubator, Ootheca Chamber, and Honeydew Pipette.
- Replaces vanilla livestock sounds with subtle nature and insect audio cues across all converted arthropods.
- Includes extensive updates to villager dialogue, marriage dialogue, cutscenes (including Shane's 8-heart event), mail, quests, festivals, TV shows, shop icons, and building/profession descriptions so the entire ranching experience stays consistent.
- Fully configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu, allowing you to toggle coop bugs, barn bugs, products, machines, tools/menus, and dialogue independently.

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55520/55520-1794628370-149502901.png[/img] Requirements[/b][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55520/55520-1794628370-149502901.png[/img] A note on donations[/b][/size]
If you like the mod, I would love to accept your donations. All donations (along with any revenue generated through the Donation Points program) will be donated to [url=https://www.stjude.org/donate/donate-to-st-jude.html]St. Jude Children's Hospital[/url] ... or you can just donate yourself and give me an updoot!
